description: Unlike the other 5 app-workplace crates, presentation's frontend (src/app.js) calls the dialog and fs plugin JS APIs DIRECTLY (t.dialog.open/save, t.fs.readFile/readTextFile/writeTextFile), so these are frontend-gated permissions, not just Rust-side plugin registration. The fs scope mirrors the v1 allowlist scope ($HOME/**, $APPDATA/**). LIMITATION (unverified without a runtime pass): a file the user picks OUTSIDE $HOME/$APPDATA (e.g. /tmp, an external volume) will be denied by fs scope even though the dialog allowed picking it — v2's fs plugin does not auto-grant dialog-picked paths.
